title: Mysterious new viruses reveal a missing link in evolution
caption:
New research using AI to scan billions of DNA sequences has uncovered a 'missing link' group of viruses. These findings suggest that the protein shells used by viruses and the internal compartments of our own cells have been evolving into each other for millions of years.

Source: Sciencedaily - Mysterious new viruses reveal a missing link in evolution
